requester.say: When it cannot wait, tick “Urgent” and say why. Whoever acts next is alerted straight away. Approvals stay the same.

stock_manager.say: When it cannot wait, tick “Urgent” and say why. Whoever acts next is alerted straight away. Approvals stay the same.

finance.say: Urgent requests come first here and in a red “Urgent” card at the top of Home, each with the reason. Open one to see why, or tap “Not urgent” and say why.

approver.say: Urgent requests come first here and in a red “Urgent” card at the top of Home. Open a waiting request and tap “Mark urgent” to have finance pay it first.

managing_director.say: An urgent request above the GM limit comes first here and at the top of Home, with the reason.
